message: inputs/warehouse_outage.json removes one warehouse from new allocations. Preserve rows already marked shipped, release only unshipped reservations from that warehouse, and create output/allocation_changes.csv. Preserve existing reservations at every other warehouse. Replan all other unfilled quantities in the original order priority. The released warehouse's stock remains in inventory_after.csv but cannot receive a new reservation. Before replacing allocations.csv, compare the prior plan with the new plan after aggregating by order_id, line_id, warehouse_id, and status. Write allocation_changes.csv with header stage,order_id,line_id,warehouse_id,status,before_qty,after_qty,delta_qty; use stage=warehouse_outage, include only nonzero changes, and sort by order_id,line_id,warehouse_id,status.
